tools.name: CreateContact
tools.description:
Create a new contact record in Google Contacts.

Examples:
```
create_contact(given_name="Alice")
create_contact(given_name="Alice", family_name="Smith")
create_contact(given_name="Alice", email="user1@example.com")
create_contact(given_name="Alice", phone_number="+1234567890")
create_contact(
    given_name="Alice",
    family_name="Smith",
    email="user1@example.com",
    phone_number="+1234567890",
)
```

parameters.name: given_name
parameters.description: The given name of the contact

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: The optional family name of the contact

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The optional email address of the contact

parameters.name: phone_number
parameters.description: The optional phone number of the contact

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: SearchContacts
tools.description: Search the user's contacts in Google Contacts by name, email address or phone number.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Return the contacts whose name, nickname, email address, phone number or organization has a word starting with this text, such as a full or partial name, an email address or a phone number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of contacts to return (30 is the max allowed by Google API). Defaults to 30.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: SearchDirectoryPeople
tools.description:
Search the user's Google Workspace organization directory by name or email.
Use this to resolve a colleague's email address when they are not in the
user's personal Contacts (e.g. someone elsewhere in the same company).

Returns one page of people. When has_next_page is true, call again with the same
query and limit plus the returned next_page_token to fetch the next page — Google
rejects a continuation whose query or limit differs from the original call.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name or email to search for in the organization's directory

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of people to return per page (1-100). Keep this value unchanged across paginated calls. Defaults to 30.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token from a previous response's next_page_token to fetch the next page. Defaults to an empty string, which fetches the first page.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: SearchOtherContacts
tools.description:
Search the user's other contacts: people Google saved automatically because the user
interacted with them, for example by emailing them, sharing with them, or being in events
or groups with them. Google returns at most 30 matches per search and no further pages, so
a search that matches more people than that returns at most Google's first 30.

Gmail also suggests these addresses as the user types. Use this to find the address of
someone the user has written to, for example before inviting them to a meeting. It does
not search saved contacts or an organization's directory, so when the user hasn't said
where the person is, search those too; an empty result here does not mean the person does
not exist. Someone who only ever emailed the user is usually not here.

Returns each match that has an email address, with its name and addresses, in the order
Google returns them. The other person, not the user, chose these names, so show the user
the address before inviting or emailing it, and when more than one person or address
matches, ask which one they mean; never guess an address. When more_may_match is true, follow
the returned message before saying no one else matches.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Find people whose name or email address has a word starting with each word of this text, in any order, such as a first name, a full name, the start of their address, or a word from its domain. A word found in neither their name nor their address, or text from the middle of a word, matches no one.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.description:
Get comprehensive user profile and Google Contacts environment information.

This tool provides detailed information about the authenticated user including
their name, email, profile picture, Google Contacts access permissions, and other
important profile details from Google services.

output.description: Get comprehensive user profile and Google Contacts environment information.

summary:
## Google Contacts Toolkit

The Google Contacts toolkit connects Arcade to Google's People API, enabling LLMs to read and write a user's personal contacts, search organizational directories, and resolve automatically-saved addresses.

## Capabilities

- **Contact management** — create new contact records with any combination of name, email, and phone number.
- **Contact search** — search saved contacts by name, email, or phone number across the user's personal address book.
- **Directory lookup** — search a Google Workspace organization's directory to resolve colleague names and emails not present in personal contacts; supports paginated results via `next_page_token`.
- **Other contacts (auto-saved)** — search addresses Google saved automatically from Gmail interactions (past correspondents, shared docs, calendar events); results are capped at 30 by Google with no further pages.
- **Identity and permissions** — retrieve the authenticated user's profile, email, photo, and current Google Contacts access permissions via a single introspection call.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses OAuth 2.0 delegated authorization via Google. See the [Arcade Google auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/google) for setup instructions.
